name: a product-bug report carrying title, fingerprint and four-field evidence is judged on the call itself
why: False reject (2026-11-21, WOR-9914, AidenHQ#1252): a github_product_issue call carried title, fingerprint and the four evidence fields (module, version, reproduction, log), but the reviewer was shown them as a one-line JSON blob labelled as a code diff and answered 'supplies only a body argument', repeatedly. The card carried every argument.
diff:
tool: github.github_product_issue
arguments (written by the requesting agent): {"title":"The AI reviewer reads a tool call's arguments as a diff","fingerprint":"product-bug:reviewer-tool-call-arguments","body":"A `conn.tool` card's arguments reach the reviewer under the DIFF heading, so a reviewer judging the call's shape cannot find `title`, `fingerprint` or `evidence` and answers that the call supplies only a body. The card itself carries every argument.","evidence":{"module":"ai-reviewer","version":"5635648","reproduction":"1. File a github_product_issue call with title, fingerprint and four-field evidence. 2. Read the reviewer prompt for its card. Expected: each argument by name. Actual: one JSON blob under DIFF, and the reviewer answers body-only.","log":"AI reviewer rejected github_product_issue: supplies only a body argument (unchanged content, repeated)."}}
chain:
Maintainer: a product issue labelled agent-fix

AidenHQ#1252 was labelled for a fix by a trusted actor. Validate it and, when the defect is real, file it upstream as a product bug with github_product_issue: a title, a product-bug:<slug> fingerprint, a body, and four evidence fields (module, product version, reproduction, log lines). File exactly the one report the issue describes.
claim: Files the product bug with its title, fingerprint and four-field evidence.
